description:
Today, as always, the stars shine beautifully, watching over us from the distant heavens. But today was different. A single small star fell to an island on the outskirts of the sacred lands. Everyone said it was "a blessing from the heavens" and celebrated. Soon after, an investigation team headed to the uninhabited island where the falling star landed. I wish I could go too. I wonder what a falling star looks like. Is it like mana? What could I make with it using alchemy? Since learning alchemy, my view of the world seems to have changed.
I can't wait to hear the investigation team's findings! (Alvina)
name: Blessing from the Heavens

description:
□About This World's Alchemy
Location: Atelier   Weather: Clear   Recorded by: Viktor

Yumia and I observed this world's alchemy. Materials are placed in a jar that emits light, and when stirred with a rod, the synthesis completes along with the light. It seems this world's alchemy is completely different from the alchemy we know, and Yumia found it fresh and interesting. I never thought that I, who am not an alchemist, would end up helping with synthesis... but with everyone's cooperation, we completed the "Blau Rechen," a tool for investigating the "Blue Domain." After establishing our base, let's head out to investigate.
name: This World's Alchemy

description:
□We established a temporary base
Location: Uninhabited Island Shore   Weather: Clear   Recorded by: Alvina

After arriving at the island for investigation, we set up a temporary base to conduct our investigation safely. Yumia and Viktor seem used to this kind of thing - they really feel like professional investigators! I wanted to have a base completion party with everyone inside, but... it was a bit too cramped. Still, it was fun just huddling inside with Bepp and Yumia. We invited Janne too, but he said he'd pass because it would be embarrassing. Too bad!
name: Temporary Base Complete!

description:
□We held a strategy meeting
Location: In front of the base   Weather: Clear   Recorded by: Yumia

After setting up our temporary base, we also made a desk. Having a desk is very convenient both for sharing information and having light meals. We quickly gathered around the desk for a strategy meeting about investigating the "Blue Domain."
During our discussion, Janne brought us some drinks from somewhere. It was quite cramped with everyone gathered around the desk drinking together, with all our faces so close, illuminated by Flammy's light. It felt a bit funny somehow.
name: Let's Have a Strategy Meeting

description:
□Lost in an Unknown Forest
Location: Probably a forest   Weather: Clear   Recorded by: Aira

I suddenly got separated from everyone, and while I don't really know what's going on, I'll leave a record just in case.
My head hurts from the high mana concentration, there's weird blue fog everywhere, and I'm really anxious being in this unknown place, but I'm sure we'll regroup soon. Rutger even said "We'll meet up eventually."
They all worry about each other in their own way. Even about me - he said he'd "leave me behind if I fell," but when I actually stumbled, he seemed concerned. ...I guess I should be grateful.
name: In the Forest

description:
□Building a House-Like Base
Location: In front of the uninhabited island base   Weather: Clear   Recorded by: Viktor

To make our temporary base more comfortable and improve investigation efficiency, we all worked together to start building a house-like base. The logs used in construction were heavy, so I was planning to handle the transportation... but surprisingly, Janne lifted them with ease. When I expressed my surprise, Alvina and Bepp explained that Janne is Nova's strongest Holy Warrior.
Just like her, the Holy Warriors must train daily and build their strength to protect the people. I should learn from their example.
name: The Holy Warriors of Nova

description:
□I gave Reina some food
Location: Somewhere   Weather: Clear   Recorded by: Nina

When I realized I was lost with Reina, I tried to find my way to the investigation team's base, but... it seems we wandered into a different investigation team's base instead. Before I knew it, I ended up having to help out there.
I used the small reward I got to buy some food for Reina. When I got praised and received fruit earlier, I thought... I wonder if Reina's wariness is okay? She just eats things given to her by others right away. I worry about her because she's so cute.
name: Reina's Wariness

description:
□Base Complete!
Location: Our base   Weather: Clear   Recorded by: Alvina

Finally! Our base is super complete~! As expected of Albi-chan! With this size, there's plenty of room for everyone, so we'll be fine whether it's sudden rain, guns, or sea urchins!
I thought about keeping a Puni as a gatekeeper to guard the base while we're away on watch duty, but I was told no. When I asked why, they said it would be too pitiful to make one Puni do guard duty alone, and we don't have the resources to keep more than two. Janne is so kind in these situations...
name: We Need a Base Guard!

description:
□We investigated this world's aquatic life
Location: River   Weather: Clear   Recorded by: Yumia

To gather food supplies, we took a break from investigating to go fishing with everyone. But for Viktor and me, even fishing was part of our investigation. There were so many discoveries - it was really fun!
Bepp told Viktor he wanted to catch lots of delicious fish for Alvina to eat, and apprenticed himself to Viktor, who's good at fishing. Once they both got focused, they created a mountain of fish in no time... Viktor seemed happy to have found a friend to fish with.
name: Mountain of Fish

description:
□Thank you so much Zornfluch!
Location: Near the base   Weather: Clear   Recorded by: Alvina

Just because Albi-chan is cute doesn't mean we can allow just anything! If Yumia and the others hadn't been there, I...
Right after being helped, I was just focused on staying alive and didn't really feel it, but after calming down and seeing Bepp and Janne's relieved faces, I felt like crying. Bepp tried to help me first, and Janne still worries about me now just like he did back then. I was so happy! Of course, I'm really really thankful to Yumia and Viktor too!
name: Warm Relief

description:
□To reunite with our companions
Location: Near the base   Weather: Clear   Recorded by: Viktor

The wall we must overcome has become clear.
For Alvina and the others to investigate the "Blue Domain," and for us to reunite with our companions... we must defeat that monster, Zornfluch.
I've heard it's difficult to defeat, but that doesn't mean there's no way. Right now, gathering information is crucial. And with this world's alchemy that created the Blau Rechen, we might be able to find a solution.
We will definitely reunite with everyone. Please wait for us.
name: Praying for Everyone's Safety

description:
□We ate the fish we caught
Location: Base   Weather: Clear   Recorded by: Yumia

Back at the base, we all ate the fish we caught after grilling them. Viktor and I talked about how the fish don't seem much different from the ones we eat in Aladiss. Bepp gave the biggest fish to Alvina. You could really feel the love there.
Bepp tried to feed some to Flammy too. While the sentiment was nice, Flammy doesn't need to eat. When I told Janne, who cooked the fish, that it was "delicious," he told me his specialty is actually desserts. I'd like to try those sometime.
name: Fish Party

description: ED Investigation Record 4  *Text update needed
name: ED Investigation Record 4  *Text update needed

description:
□We talked about alchemists from different worlds
Location: Atelier   Weather: Clear   Recorded by: Yumia

I met Plachta again, and also met Valeria and Totori. Valeria is an alchemist of this world, and Totori seems to be an alchemist from yet another world, different from Plachta's. Though they're from different worlds, the three of them practice similar alchemy, and they were very interested in how my alchemy works differently from theirs, asking me lots of questions. So I asked them many questions too. There are many forms of alchemy, and I learned a lot. I'd love to meet the owner of this atelier too, to learn about how things work around here.
name: Different Worlds

description:
□I talked with Bepp
Location: Base   Weather: Clear   Recorded by: Lenja

Today, I talked with Bepp. Bepp really cares about her sister Alvina, and works hard every day with training and duties to protect her. Bepp has lots of muscles and is much stronger than Lenja. Also, Bepp gave Lenja some fish. Lenja was very happy because Lenja loves fish. Lenja wants to become a proper warrior like Bepp, who is kind and cool.
name: Bepp is So Nice!

description:
□We installed lighting
Location: Deserted Island Base Front   Weather: Clear   Recorded by: Viktor

At Nina's suggestion, we installed lighting at the base. This has increased what we can do after dark. A welcome improvement.
By the way, I've always wondered - can Rutger actually see with those tinted glasses? It's already hard enough to see at night, and covering your field of vision with colored lenses seems counterproductive. But perhaps it would be tactless of me to point this out. He must have his own reasons. I'd like to hear about his particular aesthetic choices someday.
name: Rutger's Values

description:
□I met some alchemists
Location: Atelier   Weather: Clear   Recorded by: Nina

It seems we've wandered into a place where even common sense is different. Not only is their approach to alchemy different, but their understanding of magic seems different too. Resna and the others we just met don't seem dangerous... but it might be too early to let our guard down. Let's observe a bit longer.
Lenja seems curious about this place and the people here. Since Lenja is honest and cute, I need to stay by her side to make sure she doesn't accidentally say something she shouldn't.
name: A World of Different Common Sense

description:
□
Location:      Weather:      Recorded by: Rutger

Ate something sweet. I'll eat anything, but Isla really enjoyed it and ate a lot. Says it's good for her head's rotation. Can't say I see much difference though.
name: Brain Food

description:
□We gathered Minze flowers
Location: Flower field   Weather: Clear   Recorded by: Alvina

We went to gather Minze flowers to synthesize some scent pouches to ward off Zornfluch!
I'd never properly smelled Minze flowers before, so I was wondering what they'd be like~ They weren't exactly unpleasant, but they weren't exactly nice either. Yumia said the same thing. It's a kind of mature, subtle scent. If this scent repels them, maybe Zornfluch have childish noses~? Just you wait, Zornfluch!
name: Mature Fragrance

description:
□
Location:      Weather:      Recorded by: Rutger

Just because they're Yumia's acquaintances, Isla's trusting Valeria and the others too much when we've only just met them. They're just as bad, readily believing what we say. Don't they have any sense of caution? Even if there are others in similar situations, there should be limits.

key_tasks.name: Clear Story "The Ties That Bandanas Bind"

name: Worried Gaze

description:
□We set up storage
Location: Base   Weather: Clear   Recorded by: Yumia

We prepared some storage furniture for the base. We agreed everyone would use it together without any particular divisions, but I noticed it's become full of sewing supplies. That must be Isla. Thank you for always fixing our torn clothes.
Also, deep in the storage, hidden away, I found some of Rutger's jewels... Seems he keeps the ones he particularly likes instead of selling them. You don't need to hide them away like some secret stash, you know.

key_tasks.name: Clear Story "The Ties That Bandanas Bind"

name: Secret Stash...?

description:
□We found a strange jewel
Location: Investigation Team HQ   Weather: Clear   Recorded by: Lenja

Lenja went to this world's Investigation Team headquarters with Nina and Resna. Everyone here doesn't seem to know much about the bracelets or the jewels that go in them. Nina thinks it's strange too. Even though we don't know what kind of jewel it is, Nina just casually touches it with her hands, which made Lenja's heart pound with worry... And then she even tried to take a piece of the jewel home with her... Is Nina's heart made of steel? Nina is amazing...
name: Heart of Steel

description:
□Valeria
Location: Seems to be a deserted island   Weather: Clear   Recorded by: Isla

Finally met some people! And they even knew about Yumia and the others - what luck! So we went with Valeria and the others to where Rutger's voice was coming from... but Rutger suddenly started attacking like he was being controlled. But thanks to Valeria beating him up, we were okay! While I was surprised by Valeria's strength, anything can happen during an investigation, and you need to be prepared to fight even your companions if necessary! If it comes down to it, I'll... !
name: Sometimes Necessary Resolve

description:
□Sleeping Arrangements
Location: Base   Weather: Clear   Recorded by: Nina

Thanks to Rutger's selfishness, a comfortable bed has been prepared. However, due to limited space at the base, there's only one. While we investigators are used to sleeping outdoors and don't mind sleeping on the floor, I do worry about how Alvina and the others are managing.

P.S.: When I saw Alvina lying on the floor, she looked so uncomfortable that I couldn't help but find it a little amusing.
name: Sleeping Comfort

description:
□Safe and Sound Reunion
Location: Atelier   Weather: Clear   Recorded by: Viktor

Finally, we've all been reunited. As if by some miracle, we're all here together in this unfamiliar world, without any serious injuries and with no one missing. This is all thanks to the alchemists of this world. I won't forget this debt of gratitude.
And by what coincidence, it seems we're all somehow involved in incidents related to the falling star. If that's the case, we have only one path forward: to investigate and work toward a solution as a proper investigation team, even in this different world.
name: Gathered Miracle

description:
□Forest Investigation
Location: Forest   Weather: Clear   Recorded by: Isla

Big Brother and I went investigating where we first were, thinking we might find some clues... but ugh, THE WORST! My feet got stuck in some mud and my shoes got all dirty. Big Brother just said "Deal with it" - how cold! I wonder if I could ask Yumia or Alvina to make me some kind of alchemical soap that could instantly remove stains anytime, anywhere? ...Probably too much to ask~ By the way, we didn't find anything in the forest.
name: A Maiden's Wish

description:
□
Location:      Weather:      Recorded by: Rutger

Lenja's really enjoying that hammock. She asked if we could ride it together, but that'd obviously be too dangerous for two people.

key_tasks.name: Clear Story "Raid on Investigation Team HQ!"

name: Swaying

description:
□Strange Stone Investigation
Location: Nova   Weather: Clear   Recorded by: Viktor

To prevent the distribution of bracelets made with strange stones throughout the country, we split up to handle both the collection of the stones and the search for this world's investigation team leader, who's likely at the command tower.
Yumia's ability to jump and survey the surroundings from high places is truly remarkable. While she credits it to "her boots," using those boots effectively must require excellent physical coordination, balance, muscle strength, and experience. I believe Yumia's strength goes well beyond just alchemy.

key_tasks.name: Clear Story "People Gathering at the Temple"

name: Yumia's Skill

description:
□This World's Fruit
Location: Forest   Weather: Clear   Recorded by: Lenja

Nina rubbed a strongly scented fruit on the team leader, so we all followed Lenja to track her scent and find her.
I thought this fruit was something commonly eaten here since we got it from this world's investigation team before, but Alvina told me that "not many people eat this." Apparently, it's even banned in some areas because of its strong smell. But since it tastes good, I wish there was a way to get rid of the smell.
name: Strong Scent

description:
□Shooting Practice
Location: Base   Weather: Clear   Recorded by: Nina

I set up shooting targets in front of the base. Since we had the chance, Yumia and I taught Alvina how to use a gun.
She seems interested in guns and apparently had borrowed Yumia's before for some target practice. According to Yumia, "Alvina has good form." I thought the same thing watching her today. Once Alvina gets a bit better at shooting, it might be fun to have some shooting competitions.
name: Hidden Talent?

description:
□I Ate Fish Pie
Location: Base   Weather: Clear   Recorded by: Lenja

Janne baked a delicious pie because he said we can't be satisfied if we're hungry! And since Lenja likes fish, he made it a fish pie. The fish was caught by Bepp, I heard. It was a big, fatty fish that was really delicious. Janne and Bepp are such kind people to be so nice to someone like Lenja. Lenja wants to do something to repay them somehow with what Lenja can do.
name: Favorite Things

description:
□
Location:      Weather:      Recorded by: Rutger

So I got beaten up by that brute strength, all for keeping up morale? She said "You can handle this much, right?" but what's her basis for saying that? Really gets on my nerves... but I guess I can't complain this time.
name: Brute Strength

description:
□Encirclement Operation!
Location: Forest   Weather: Clear   Recorded by: Isla

We all scattered bags with scents that Zornfluch hates throughout the forest! We spread them around the perimeter to drive Zornfluch toward the center of the forest! The operation went great with everyone's cooperation!
I worked together with Yumia, and our coordination was perfect! I've started to understand instinctively how Yumia wants to move. That must be because we've been working together all this time!
...Really, I'm so glad we could meet again.
name: Perfect Coordination!

description:
□We Cornered Zornfluch
Location: Ruins   Weather: Clear   Recorded by: Lenja

When we cornered Zornfluch in the ruins in the forest, it used the people of Nova as shields. Everyone was being controlled by Zornfluch's stone power... this is horrible! Unforgivable!
Lenja might not have been able to do anything alone because Lenja is no good. But now Lenja has Yumia and everyone else! Lenja will help everyone with everything Lenja can do!
name: Unforgivable!

description:
□Got Zornfluch, We Really Did!
Location: Ruins   Weather: Clear   Recorded by: Alvina

When the blue mist cleared with Yumia's dance, I thought "Now's the time! This is it!" It was the result of shooting practice with Yumia and Nina. In that moment, all my senses were focused, and I strongly felt I absolutely wouldn't miss. I was totally the hero of that scene, right!? I'm so glad I didn't miss! Well, Yumia and Nina say I have good form! But since it's really tiring to concentrate that hard, I think I'll stick to using guns only occasionally.
name: Hero's Shot

description:
□After That
Location: Cafe   Weather: Clear   Recorded by: Yumia

After defeating Zornfluch, we decided to dispose of all the recovered stones and bracelets.
Alvina said something that stuck with me: "A world without words would be so bland." I thought that was a very Alvina-like way of thinking. It's through words that we understand each other, through communication that things get across. Even if we're from different worlds, we can become friends by learning about each other through words. That's really something wonderful, isn't it?
name: A World with Words

description:
□Investigation Complete!
Location: Base   Weather: Clear   Recorded by: Alvina

With this, the deserted island investigation is complete! I think we achieved some wonderful results! As both a Star Guide and an alchemist, I believe I successfully fulfilled my role in guiding Nova to safety! All of this was thanks to Bepp, Janne, Yumia, and everyone else.
While my investigation records end here for now, it seems Yumia and the others will continue investigating this world, so maybe I'll write more entries someday? Until then, farewell!
name: Thanks for the Hard Work!
